channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Kurt Rambis | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Kurt Rambis from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Kevin Love on Kurt Rambis
item.description:
“Maybe at some point you’ll step out and take a couple, but that’s not why we brought you here.’It wasn’t really until Kurt Rambis, my third year, really pushed me into shooting 3s and kind of saw where the game was evolving and leading to.”

Kevin Love on Kurt Rambis, Jun 1, 2026. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Luke Walton on Phil Jackson, Kurt Rambis
item.description:
“Not only (because of Jackson) but I played under Kurt Rambis for a lot of years, and there's people out here that I wanted to see succeed. I love the triangle offense. I wanted to see that work. But for whatever reasons it didn't.”

Luke Walton on Phil Jackson, Kurt Rambis, Dec 12, 2017. Source: New York Daily News.

item.title: Carmelo Anthony on Kurt Rambis
item.description:
Steve Popper:Carmelo Anthony on Kurt Rambis as defensive coach:

“Whether we’re comfortable with it or not, it is what it is, and we got to buy into that and embrace that”

Carmelo Anthony on Kurt Rambis, Nov 8, 2016. Source: Twitter @StevePopper.

item.title: David Kahn on Kurt Rambis
item.description:
“I think last year it was confusing to me at times that we probably weren't pushing the open-court style as much as I think we had first envisioned when I spoke to (Rambis) two years ago,”

David Kahn on Kurt Rambis, Jul 13, 2011. Source: St. Paul Pioneer Press.

item.title: Michael Beasley on Kurt Rambis
item.description:
Michael Beasley on Kurt Rambis:

“I love Rambis, a great guy, a great coach, he knows a lot about the game. But at the same time, it’s a cutthroat business. I don’t want him to go anywhere but if he does, that’s the business.”

Michael Beasley on Kurt Rambis, Jul 2, 2011. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Glen Taylor on Kurt Rambis
item.description:
“Because I’m asking those guys to put together the information for me (on Rambis).”

Glen Taylor on Kurt Rambis, Apr 16, 2011. Source: CBSSports.com.
